statement: Guru Chandal Yoga (Jupiter and Rahu sharing a sign) is traditionally read as carrying either unconventional or foreign-oriented wisdom, or -- in its more commonly emphasized reading -- a distortion of Jupiter's normally ethical, expansive nature, heavily dependent on the rest of the chart.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
